pages.text: At $(bold)level 40$() the System gives you a $(bold)Job Change Quest Key$(). Clear the quest and you get one of three jobs.$(br2)$(bold)Shadow Monarch$(): raise dead mobs as shadow soldiers. Igris, Tusk and Beru get half your health and armour, others a quarter. Their damage scales with your Intelligence.

$(bold)Grand Mage$(): magic damage.$(br)$(bold)Frost Monarch$(): ice.$(br2)Do the quest again to re-roll; you never get the same job twice in a row. You get another key every 50 levels from level 100.

$(bold)Shadow Monarch tips$()$(br)Shadows are called from the shadow menu in the System panel. They vanish when you log out, die or change dimension. That is normal: call them again. Beat Igris in his Gate and right-click his body 3 times to raise him.
